title: Evaluation of the Impact of a Smartphone App on Adherence to an Exercise Program in People With Chronic Low Back Pain: Randomized Controlled Trial
comparison_or_design: The primary exercise-app comparison during usual multidisciplinary rehabilitation.
observations_or_assays: Exercise Adherence Rating Scale Part B
Pain intensity on the Numeric Rating Scale
time_scope: The 6-month comparison and each outcome’s explicitly reported baseline/reference assessment.
excluded: Separately designated confirmation models, other sensitivity versions, standalone within-arm/trajectory tests and calculated changes
population_or_material: The intention-to-treat population in the chronic-low-back-pain exercise-app trial.
requested_items: EARS/NRS/ODI: Table 1 baseline arm mean/SD and Table 2 six-month arm mean/SD, main-text adjusted between-group differences with CI/P, and all Table 2 effect sizes (ES) with their own CI/P. Preserve Table 2 NRS scale; do not rescale from conflicting prose. Do not infer ES formula/sign or model denominator from follow-up counts. Exclude the separately labelled confirmatory EARS comparison.
